title: Magnetic Couplings & Pumps
painPoint: Magnetic couplings and sealless pumps rely on NdFeB magnets to transmit torque through hermetically sealed barriers, eliminating dynamic seals and preventing leakage of hazardous fluids. However, maintaining torque density at elevated operating temperatures remains challenging. When pump media reach 120-200 degrees C, standard N42 or N48 grades suffer irreversible flux loss, reducing coupling efficiency and risking catastrophic failure. Additionally, corrosive environments demand superior coating integrity, while high-speed rotation induces eddy current losses that heat magnets and accelerate demagnetization. Engineers struggle to source magnets that simultaneously deliver high BHmax, adequate Hcj at temperature, and corrosion resistance for API 685 compliant sealless pump designs.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU provides specialized NdFeB magnets including 42SH, 38UH, and 35EH grades engineered for magnetic couplings and sealless pump applications. NiCuNi multi-layer and PTFE coating options ensure salt spray resistance exceeding 72 hours for corrosive fluid handling.
